name: One More Piece
summary:
Your younger brother has gotten into your room again. He took your building blocks, stuck them together into a messy, oversized, and awkward-looking lump, dumped it onto your desk, and even left a note. According to him, it’s a rocket. It is not a rocket.

So, you sit down at your desk. Sunlight streams in through the window, and outside, little birds are chirping. Now, let’s take this jumbled mess and put everything back the way it was—piece by piece.
